# Metric catalog

Canonical metrics of OpenFactsheet methodology 0.1.0. Every report computes all of them; a metric that cannot be computed is reported with a status and a reason, never omitted. Exact formulas: [formulas](reference/formulas.md); thresholds: [policies](reference/policies.md); all decision rules: [criteria](reference/criteria.md).

Reference column: ✓ agrees with the OpenFactsheet convention, ≠ documented convention difference (see [reference implementations](validation/reference_implementations.md)).
